title: Subqueries and CTEs
description: Write nested queries and Common Table Expressions (CTEs) to break down complex problems. Learn about correlated subqueries, IN, EXISTS, and recursive CTEs.
whatYouLearn: What a subquery is and how to nest a SELECT inside WHERE, SELECT, or FROM
How to use IN, ANY, ALL, and EXISTS to work with subquery results
How correlated subqueries reference the outer query on every row
How CTEs (WITH clause) make complex queries more readable than subqueries
How recursive CTEs generate hierarchical results like org charts or bill-of-materials
